standard_prerequisites: A Lie algebroid (A, rho, [-,-]) over a smooth manifold M, with the local coordinate setup delivered inside the proof: coordinates x^i on M, fiber bases e_a of A and dual e^a of A*, anchor expression rho(e_a) = rho_a^i(x) partial_i, bracket [e_a, e_b] = C_{ab}^c(x) e_c, and the two Lie algebroid identities (LAidentity1) with the Cicly terms.

A Hamiltonian Lie algebroid over a Poisson manifold: the defining axioms (P1), (P2), (P3) are restated in full inside the proof (source lines 1033-1050) as equations (Pms12), (Pms13); the definition environment itself (source lines 739-743, label HamiltonianLAS) is standing setup and cites [Blohmann:2018] externally, outside the span.

A momentum section mu, a TM-connection nabla on A with connection 1-form omega, and the local coordinate expressions of the A-torsion, the curvature and the basic curvature (lcAtosion, lcbasiccurv), all delivered inside the proof; the Poisson condition [pi, pi]_S = 0 (Poissonidentity) likewise in-span.
core_obligations: In a Hamiltonian Lie algebroid over a Poisson manifold, pi^sharp <^A S, mu> = 0, where < -, - > is the pairing of A and A*.
proof_roadmap: Set up the local coordinate expressions in-span: Lie algebroid identities (LAidentity1), Poisson identity (Poissonidentity), torsion/curvature/basic-curvature formulas (lcAtosion, lcbasiccurv), and the Hamiltonian axioms (P1), (P2) = (Pms12), (P3) = (Pms13).
Substitute (Pms12) into the Lie algebroid identity (LAidentity1) and use the Poisson identity to obtain (LAIden111); rewrite it covariantly to get (identity11).

Substitute (Pms12) into (Pms13), use the Poisson identity and (lcAtosion) to get the covariant form (P3covlocal); act with nabla_j and use (lcbasiccurv) to obtain (identity12); multiply by pi^{ij} to obtain (identity13).

Compare (identity11) and (identity13), noting nabla_j pi^{kl} = partial_j pi^{kl} since no TM-connection is introduced on TM; their consistency forces pi^{ij} S_{jab}^c mu_c = 0, i.e. pi^sharp <^A S, mu> = 0.
